def lca(u, v, parent):
    if depth[u] < depth[v]:
        u, v = v, u
    diff = depth[u] - depth[v]
    while diff > 0:
        u = parent[u][int(diff.bit_length()) - 1]
        diff &= diff - 1
    if u == v:
        return u
